thesis: In the supplied 128-node synthetic stencil workload, coordinating incremental checkpoints reduced measured checkpoint interruption while preserving recovery coverage.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.goal: Establish the checkpoint-interruption problem for large HPC applications and state the bounded central argument.

sections.title: Background
sections.goal: Present two background examples of checkpoint coordination approaches and situate the coordinator design.

sections.title: Coordinator Design
sections.goal: Describe the incremental checkpoint coordinator architecture and its coordination protocol.

sections.title: Evaluation
sections.goal: Report the fixture benchmark results: baseline vs. coordinated incremental interruption and recovery coverage.

sections.title: Discussion
sections.goal: Interpret results within the bounded scenario and identify limitations of the fixture corpus.

sections.title: Conclusion
sections.goal: Restate the bounded contribution and outline directions for future work beyond the fixture scenario.
